output.subject: Your request about personal items in your vehicle
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for speaking with us about your vehicle. We understand this is a stressful time, and we're sorry for the worry this situation has caused you.

You told us your vehicle has been repossessed, and you were open with us that you had fallen behind on payments. You mentioned that some important personal belongings are still inside the car, including your work tools and your child's car seat. You also told us you are starting a new job on 9/13 and need your tools for it, so we understand why getting these items back matters so much to you right now.

During your call, our representative shared the storage lot's information and hours with you. Your request to retrieve your personal items has been passed to our Collections & Recoveries team, who will review it. We will respond to you within 10 business days.

If anything changes in the meantime, or if there is anything you would like to add, please reply to this message and we'll include it in the review.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Customer starts a new job on 9/13 and needs the work tools; the 10-business-day reply may land after that date, so consider whether faster contact is needed.
A child car seat is among the items; confirm whether the customer can collect it promptly.
Confirm the storage lot details and hours given on the call are accurate and whether the customer can collect items directly there.
Decide what, if anything, to say about the item retrieval process, required ID, or any fees before sending.
Confirm whether the customer has already tried to collect items since the call.
